findings.title: DRAM bandwidth field has an eightfold GB/s versus Gbit/s ambiguity
findings.unique_fix: Use decimal dram_bandwidth_bytes_per_second=64000000000, freeze clock_hz and derived dram_bytes_per_cycle=192, and make the simulator reject inconsistency.

findings.title: Fixed throughput numerators, population grain, density bins and aggregation weighting are not SHA-frozen
findings.unique_fix: Before any run, SHA-pin one measurement_population_and_numerator_manifest containing sequence/frame IDs and trace SHAs, both scalar numerators, the OP convention, non-MAC rules, density thresholds and exact aggregation formulas.

findings.title: Area-normalized throughput is not an iso-area comparison
findings.unique_fix: Keep native fairness labels separate from derived area metrics and set iso_area_claim_allowed=false unless a post-DC-plus-macro area-budgeted resource rescaling and rerun protocol is frozen.

findings.title: Waterfall steps are not all registered resource configurations and can confound mechanism gain with K1-to-K8 service scaling
findings.unique_fix: Register every step with full resource identity; call only same-resource adjacent ratios mechanism gains, label resource-changing ratios architecture-stack scaling, and use B3 K1x8 to C2 typed K8 as the C2 equal-service ablation.

findings.title: External adapters lack machine fields for supported scope, fallback and full-network status
The locally defined PTB-like B1 needs a fixed label that cannot be shortened to official PTB
